```{r}

hrdata <- read.csv("HR-Employee-Attrition.csv")

```


```{r}

# Create a list of numeric columns

num_cols <- c("Age", "TotalWorkingYears")

```

```{r}

hrdata_num <- hrdata[, num_cols]

```


```{r}

cor(hrdata_num)

```


```{r}

pairs(~ MonthlyIncome + Age + TotalWorkingYears, data = hrdata, main = "Scatterplot Matrix")

```



```{r}

hrdata$EducationLabel <- factor(
  hrdata$Education,
  levels = 1:5,
  labels = c(
    "Below College",
    "College",
    "Bachelor",
    "Master",
    "Doctor"
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)


table(hrdata$EducationLabel, useNA = "ifany")


```



```{r}

boxplot(
  Age ~ EducationLabel,
  data = hrdata,
  main = "Age by Education Level",
  xlab = "Education",
  ylab = "Age",
  outline = TRUE,
  pch = 1
)

```

```{r}

boxplot(
  TotalWorkingYears ~ EducationLabel,
  data = hrdata,
  main = "Total Working Years by Education Level",
  xlab = "Education",
  ylab = "Total Working Years",
  outline = TRUE,
  pch = 1
)

```



```{r}

boxplot(
  MonthlyIncome ~ EducationLabel,
  data = hrdata,
  main = "Monthly Income by Education Level",
  xlab = "Education",
  ylab = "Monthly Income",
  outline = TRUE,
  pch = 1
)

```

```{r}

boxplot(Age ~ Attrition,
    data = hrdata,
    main = "Age Distribution by Attrition",
    xlab = "Attrition Status", ylab = "Age")

```


```{r}

yes_age <- hrdata[(hrdata$Attrition == "Yes"), 'Age']
no_age <- hrdata[(hrdata$Attrition != "Yes"), 'Age']

```


```{r}

t.test(yes_age, no_age)

```



```{r}

yes_empno <- hrdata[(hrdata$Attrition == "Yes"), 'EmployeeNumber']
no_empno <- hrdata[(hrdata$Attrition != "Yes"), 'EmployeeNumber']

t.test(yes_empno, no_empno)

```
```{r}

model1 = lm(MonthlyIncome ~ Age, data = hrdata)
summary(model1)

```


```{r}

# Create a model with two inputs
model2 <- lm(MonthlyIncome ~ Age + TotalWorkingYears, data = hrdata)

# See the results
summary(model2)

```
